text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: rhetorical negative-question opening
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:ʾa-lam}}) fuses question and negation to open the ayah as a rebuke that still seeks response. Its jussive force governs the next verb, so the audience hears an overdue-recognition question before the demand is even named. The fused surface and sharp opening catch also arrest the recitation and launch a new thematic unit with immediate pressure.

topics.headline: question-shaped rebuke opens a still-correctable warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a rebuke demanding inward assent, not as a neutral question or sealed verdict.
topics.reason: QAC marks the fused interrogative plus jussive particle, while discourse and boundary rows show the opening functions as admonition after the closed verdict of 57:15.

topics.headline: fused surface and glottal onset compress the arresting force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the first surface unit arrests the recitation and starts a new thematic unit with immediate pressure.
topics.reason: Form and phonetic rows cohere with the particle analysis; the section-marker row is treated as structural setting, not as a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: overdue threshold arrival, not bare chronology
words.root_gloss_range: arrival at an appointed threshold, with ripening and readiness pressure; local grammar selects the overdue arrival of the heart-response.
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْنِ}} ({{tr:yaʾni}}) names the moment as having reached its due threshold, with readiness and ripening pressure rather than mere elapsed time. Its jussive, weak-verb shape keeps that threshold inside the opening rebuke, while variant evidence shows how this same pressure point could be heard through clarity rather than timing.

topics.headline: ripened arrival rather than generic time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded response has reached a due threshold, like something ripened or ready, rather than merely appearing after clock-time.
topics.reason: Dictionary and rarity evidence support the threshold/ripening range, and QAC confirms the local finite verb governed by the opening negative question.

topics.headline: jussive weak-verb shape and variants expose the pressure point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threshold verb is grammatically clipped under the rebuke, while variant readings show the same slot could be heard through clarity rather than timing.
topics.reason: The canonical QAC parse remains the jussive threshold verb; accepted variants are kept as contrast and form pressure, not as replacements for the local reading.

words.gloss_range: dative target of the ripened moment
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) assigns the arrived moment to the believers. Time is not just passing around them; it has become a pressure for them.

topics.headline: dative li assigns the moment to believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the due moment is directed at the believers as their obligation, not left as general chronology.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition as dative or beneficiary marking, matching the CRITICAL claim that the threshold is assigned to the addressed group.

words.gloss_range: defined believer class under the first relative pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the addressees a definite relative class, identified by the following faith verb. The first relative frame also prepares the later comparison with another relative class. Nearby same-surah links make this believer address part of a community-sorting warning frame (57:13; 57:27).

topics.headline: defined believer class prepares the comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are not vague hearers but a definite faith-defined class placed opposite a later comparison class.
topics.reason: QAC marks a genitive masculine plural relative pronoun governed by li; local discourse supports the mirrored relative-pronoun frame.

topics.headline: nearby surah links keep the warning communal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressed believer class sits inside a nearby surah pattern of community sorting and failed reception (57:13; 57:27).
topics.reason: The cross-reference rows are useful for section-level resonance, but they do not redefine the local relative pronoun.

words.gloss_range: established faith identity under renewed testing
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and entering a relation of faith; the local Form IV perfect marks an established believer identity under renewed testing.
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) names the audience by an already established act of faith. The security-and-trust field makes the rebuke sharper: those who entered trust are now asked whether that identity has reached the heart.

topics.headline: perfect faith identity is tested by heart response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuke addresses people already marked by faith, so belief as prior identity still needs inward responsiveness.
topics.reason: QAC confirms a perfect Form IV verb in the relative clause; the omitted complement makes the faith identity broad enough to be tested by the rest of the ayah.

topics.headline: faith carries security and trust pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith is not bare assent here; the trust-and-security root field makes hardening a betrayal of an entered relation.
topics.reason: V4 root senses and QAC Form IV evidence support trust/security pressure, while boundary rows connect the move from denial in 57:15 to correctable believers in 57:16.

words.gloss_range: infinitival payload of the overdue moment
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the following heart-yielding clause into what has become due. The ayah does not ask whether time has arrived in general, but whether it has arrived for this response.

topics.headline: an-clause names the overdue response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that heart-yielding is the very content of what has become due, not an afterthought after the time arrives.
topics.reason: QAC marks the subjunctive particle governing the following verb, and attachment evidence supports the following clause as the demanded response.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive heart-yielding as the demanded response
words.root_gloss_range: lowering, yielding, and receptive humility; locally applied to hearts as the demanded response to reminder and revealed truth.
words.prose: {{ar:تَخْشَعَ}} ({{tr:takhshaʿa}}) states the overdue response as inward yielding. Its humility field is tactile and receptive, and it will be answered later by the opposite heart-state of hardening. The feminine singular agreement treats the broken-plural hearts collectively, and the softer fricative texture helps the yielding-hardening contrast be heard.

topics.headline: subjunctive yielding is the required heart-action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded response is inward yielding and receptivity, not merely outward compliance.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the subjunctive imperfect Form I verb; lexical rows support lowering, softening, and receptive humility as the local heart-action.

topics.headline: yielding anticipates the later hardening contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah frames two possible heart-states: porous humility now or hard impermeability in the warning example.
topics.reason: The later verb-subject pair and contextual profiles support the local contrast between yielding and hardening without requiring the later word to govern this one.

topics.headline: feminine agreement and soft sound support the collective heart scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the collective grammar of broken-plural hearts and the softer sound texture, while the canonical demand remains the same.
topics.reason: QAC supports feminine singular agreement with the broken plural; variant and phonetic rows are kept as form texture rather than independent semantic control.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural hearts as the first hinge
words.root_gloss_range: turning or changeability of the inner organ; locally the possessed plural hearts are the subjects that must yield.
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:qulūbuhum}}) makes the believers' own hearts the subject of the required yielding. The plural possession distributes the demand across inner centers while setting up the later repetition under hardening. Because the heart is named as the organ of turning, the ayah hinges on whether that inner organ turns toward yielding or toward hardness.

topics.headline: believers own the hearts that must yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demand lands inside the believers themselves: their own plural hearts are the grammatical subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks the possessed broken plural as the subject of the yielding verb, supporting both possession and distributed accountability.

topics.headline: the turning organ becomes the ayah hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heart is a turning organ placed between two outcomes: yielding here and hardening later.
topics.reason: V4 root senses support the turning-heart image, and discourse rows show the same possessed plural returning with an opposite predicate.

words.gloss_range: responsive cause for heart-yielding
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) marks the reminder as the stimulus before which hearts should yield. Together with the earlier dative, the two li-prepositions frame both target and trigger.

topics.headline: li marks reminder as the heart-yielding stimulus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hearts are asked to yield in response to reminder, not in an undefined emotional vacuum.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition before the construct reminder, and attachment evidence supports a causal or responsive relation.

topics.headline: paired li prepositions frame target and trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a tight prepositional frame: the due moment is for the believers, and the yielding is for the reminder.
topics.reason: The structural rows compare the two local li-prepositions; QAC supports both as prepositional attachments in the opening demand.

words.gloss_range: divine reminder as memory, mention, and revealed address
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, reminder, and revealed reminder; locally a construct verbal noun bound to the divine name.
words.prose: {{ar:ذِكْرِ}} ({{tr:dhikri}}) is a construct verbal noun, so remembrance is directly bound to the divine name. Its range keeps inner recollection, spoken mention, admonition, and scripture-title pressure active together, including the wider reminder-title usage (15:9; 38:1).

topics.headline: construct reminder belongs directly to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the stimulus is God-bound reminder, not generic recollection.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verbal noun in construct with the divine name, and attachment evidence supports it as a stimulus for heart-yielding.

topics.headline: memory, mention, admonition, and scripture-title pressure remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reminder here can be inwardly remembered, verbally mentioned, and textually heard as revealed admonition.
topics.reason: V4 senses support the broad reminder range; the male-derivative row is kept only as lexical-family background and does not enter the local sense.

words.gloss_range: divine name anchoring the reminder
words.root_gloss_range: the proper divine name, with worship and derivational awe in the background; locally it anchors whose reminder is in view.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) fixes the reminder as belonging to God. The word keeps the heart-response from being a generic pious mood; it is response to God's own reminder. Worship-and-awe derivation pressure enriches the name while the local grammar still uses it as the proper possessor of reminder.

topics.headline: divine name anchors whose reminder it is
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heart-response is to God's own reminder, not to a detached moral theme.
topics.reason: QAC marks the proper name as genitive possessor of the construct reminder; contextual pairings support its saturation of the reminder and descent frame.

topics.headline: worship and awe derivations enrich but do not rename the local referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the worship-and-awe pressure around the divine name while the local grammar still uses it as the proper possessor of reminder.
topics.reason: Dictionary-derived pressures are compatible with the proper-name function but are not treated as competing local senses.

words.gloss_range: coordinating the second humbling trigger
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the divine reminder to the descended truth as a second trigger for humility. The particle broadens the stimulus without leaving the same demanded heart-response. As the first of the ayah's connector turns, it also begins a movement from added stimulus to prohibition to final verdict.

topics.headline: wa coordinates or explains the descended truth as a second trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah widens the heart's stimulus from God's reminder to what came down of the truth.
topics.reason: QAC marks a conjunction coordinating the revealed content with the reminder; the explicative possibility is preserved as a nuance, not forced.

topics.headline: first wa begins a sequence of connective turns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first wa is part of a larger ayah movement from added stimulus to prohibition to final verdict.
topics.reason: Discourse rows track the local sequence of waw functions; QAC confirms the particle positions.

words.gloss_range: open relative content of revelation
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) leaves the revealed content open while bounding it by the descent verb that follows. The heart is asked to respond not to an abstract idea but to what has actually come down.

topics.headline: relative ma leaves content open but descent-bound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the revelation is introduced as whatever has descended of truth, open in content but bounded by actual descent.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the relative pronoun referring to revealed content, matching the CRITICAL claim that the following verb bounds it.

words.gloss_range: completed descent of revelation
words.root_gloss_range: descent, alighting, and arrival from above; locally a completed revelation-event without an overt sender in the surface verb.
words.prose: {{ar:نَزَلَ}} ({{tr:nazala}}) presents the revealed truth as a completed descent. The form foregrounds the arrival of the content while passive and transitive variants can foreground sender-agency more directly. Corpus links show why descent language belongs naturally with Book and truth.

topics.headline: perfect descent presents revelation as arrived
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the truth as something that has come down and arrived, not merely as an idea available for reflection.
topics.reason: QAC confirms a Form I perfect verb; V4 and collocation evidence support descent as the local revelation frame.

topics.headline: variants test agency while canonical form foregrounds descended content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical surface keeps the content's descent prominent, while variant forms can foreground sender-agency more directly.
topics.reason: Variant rows are retained as contrast; the local QAC parse remains Form I perfect active with no overt sender attached to this word.

words.gloss_range: source or explanation from the truth
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) can mark source, partitive relation, or explanation. Locally it binds the descended content to the truth without forcing a single narrow prepositional gloss. Across the ayah, the min-prepositions distribute truth-source, prior-time, and final subset.

topics.headline: min binds revelation to truth as source, part, or explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the descended content is grammatically tied to the truth, while the preposition allows source, partitive, and explanatory shades.
topics.reason: QAC gives source or partitive value; CRITICAL rows add the explanatory possibility without forcing one exclusive gloss.

topics.headline: three min-prepositions distribute source, time, and subset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah uses min to organize truth-source, prior-time, and final subset.
topics.reason: The structural comparison is local across the ayah and is supported by QAC prepositional tags for each occurrence.

words.gloss_range: definite binding truth
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, right, and binding due; locally the definite truth is the content or source from which revelation comes.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) names the descended content as the known, binding truth. The root range fuses factual reality with right and due claim, so the revelation presses on the heart as obligation as well as information. Divine-name pressure remains a theological resonance around the truth (22:6; 22:62; 31:30), while the local grammar keeps the revealed truth as the selected sense.

topics.headline: the truth is known, real, and binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the descended content is not generic truthfulness but the definite, binding truth that lays claim on the heart.
topics.reason: QAC marks the definite genitive verbal noun, and V4 senses support reality, right, and due-claim pressure in this local object.

topics.headline: divine-name pressure enriches the truth without replacing the local noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a theological weight around the truth as a divine-name field, while local grammar still reads the word as the revealed truth governed by min.
topics.reason: Cross-references to divine-name uses (22:6; 22:62; 31:30) are valid resonance but do not turn this local noun into an explicit proper name.

words.gloss_range: pivot from positive demand to prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the negative comparison to the positive demand for humbled hearts. The connector makes the ayah's instruction two-sided: yield to reminder and do not become like the prior failed group.

topics.headline: wa pivots from demand to prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah pairs the positive call to humbled hearts with a direct warning not to become the failed example.
topics.reason: QAC marks the conjunction, and discourse evidence supports the transition from coordinated demand to prohibition.

words.gloss_range: negation blocking the comparison-state
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) blocks the feared state-transition before it is named. Its force is not a detached denial but the negative side of the ayah's exhortation.

topics.headline: la blocks becoming like the exemplar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative clause functions as prevention: the believers must not enter the likeness about to be described.
topics.reason: QAC marks the negative particle before the subjunctive verb; contextual polarity rows support prohibitive force rather than bare description.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive becoming into likeness
words.root_gloss_range: being and becoming; locally a feared transition into likeness, held in subjunctive potential.
words.prose: {{ar:يَكُونُوا۟}} ({{tr:yakūnū}}) makes the danger a potential becoming, not an accomplished fact about the believers. The warning is ontological: do not enter the state of resembling the failed exemplar. A person-shift variant can intensify the address as direct second-person warning, while the canonical surface remains third-person plural in this frame.

topics.headline: subjunctive becoming keeps the danger potential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believers are warned against a possible state they could become, not told that they already are the failed group.
topics.reason: QAC confirms subjunctive imperfect coordinated with the earlier demand; discourse rows support the negative-comparison frame as potential becoming.

topics.headline: person-shift variant intensifies address without replacing the canonical third person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant person-shift can make the warning more directly second-person, while the canonical local form remains third-person plural under the prohibitive frame.
topics.reason: Variant evidence is retained as addressee-pressure; QAC alignment keeps the local word as third-person masculine plural.

words.gloss_range: comparison particle naming the negative likeness
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) introduces explicit likeness to the comparison group. It makes the warning concrete by giving believers a pattern they must not reproduce.

topics.headline: comparison ka makes the warning concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not leave failure abstract; it gives a specific likeness the believers must avoid.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the comparison preposition governing the following relative pronoun, matching the explicit negative-simile claim.

words.gloss_range: second relative class as exemplar group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) introduces the group used for comparison, balancing the first relative class of believers. The mirrored frame sets active faith beside passive scripture-reception, and the given-the-Book comparison belongs to a recognizable Quranic warning formula.

topics.headline: second relative pronoun mirrors the believer class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a balanced frame: those who believed are warned not to become like those who were given the Book.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the second genitive relative pronoun under the comparison particle, and discourse rows support the mirrored relative-class structure.

topics.headline: given-the-Book formula marks a known warning type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison belongs to a recognizable Quranic warning frame about communities given scripture.
topics.reason: Collocation evidence supports the formulaic frame without changing the local pronoun function.

words.gloss_range: passive receipt of scripture
words.root_gloss_range: coming, bringing, giving, and arrival; locally passive perfect reception foregrounds the granted scripture rather than the giver.
words.prose: {{ar:أُوتُوا۟}} ({{tr:ūtū}}) marks the exemplar group by what they were given, not by active believing. The passive perfect makes scripture-reception a completed background privilege that can still end badly.

topics.headline: passive perfect foregrounds received privilege
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exemplar group is marked by completed reception of scripture, a privilege that does not guarantee a living heart-response.
topics.reason: QAC confirms perfect passive Form I; attachment and role profiles support the group as receivers of the Book.

topics.headline: active believing contrasts passive being-given
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency contrast between the addressed believers' active faith and the prior group's passive receipt.
topics.reason: Local morphology supports active perfect faith at word 5 versus passive perfect receipt here; root arrival imagery remains secondary to the giving frame.

words.gloss_range: the received Book as written obligation
words.root_gloss_range: writing, prescription, decree, and joined inscription; locally the definite Book is the received scripture-code.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبَ}} ({{tr:al-kitāba}}) is the definite object received by the prior group. The writing-and-prescription field makes the gift a scripture-code with obligation, not only a text in the abstract. Its Book-giving frame also joins the surah's revelation-lineage thread (57:25).

topics.headline: definite Book is the received scripture-code
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what was received is a definite scripture-code, so the warning concerns mishandled revelation, not lack of access.
topics.reason: QAC marks the definite noun as accusative object of the passive giving; V4 evidence supports writing, prescription, and decree pressure.

topics.headline: Book belongs to the giving-and-descent network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Book, giving, and descent form a revelation-lineage thread in the surah (57:25).
topics.reason: Collocation and same-surah rows support the revelation-lineage frame while the local grammar keeps this word as the object received.

words.gloss_range: temporal source before the present audience
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) marks the prior location in time. It positions the comparison group before the believers without making the warning remote.

topics.headline: min marks the prior time-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exemplar group is placed before the current audience in time, making history part of the warning.
topics.reason: QAC identifies min here as temporal, matching the CRITICAL row.

words.gloss_range: prior-time orientation
words.root_gloss_range: facing, receiving, and what is before; locally a frozen temporal adverb pointing to the prior community.
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلُ}} ({{tr:qabla}}) fixes the exemplar as before the present audience. The root's facing-front range makes temporal priority feel like an orientation the believers are forced to face.

topics.headline: frozen before-adverb fixes the prior position
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior group is grammatically fixed as before, with the elided comparison point supplied by the present audience.
topics.reason: QAC marks a noun of time with cut construct behavior; grammar rows support the adverbialized prior-time function.

topics.headline: before is also a facing orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior group is not merely earlier on a timeline; they stand as a facing example before the believers.
topics.reason: V4 root evidence supports facing and acceptance alongside temporal-before, while local grammar selects the temporal adverb.

words.gloss_range: first consequence link
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) launches the causal sequence after the prior scripture-reception frame. It makes the lengthening of the span the next consequence rather than a loose background note, and it sets up the second fa that will carry the chain into hardening.

topics.headline: first fa launches the degradation chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the narrative turns causally: after scripture-reception, prolonged time is the next linked step toward hardening.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as consequence/result, and discourse rows support the double-fa causal chain.

words.gloss_range: lengthened span pressing upon them
words.root_gloss_range: length, extension, height, and capacity; locally the span has grown long upon the comparison group.
words.prose: {{ar:طَالَ}} ({{tr:ṭāla}}) says the span grew long upon the prior group. Duration becomes a burden and an over-extension, not neutral time. The perfect form makes that lengthening a completed stage in the exemplar chain, and the uncommon finite verb gives the stage diagnostic weight. Capacity and means associations remain background color while prolonged duration is the local sense.

topics.headline: lengthened time grows upon the prior group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices duration as a burden pressing upon the community, not as neutral historical distance.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the perfect Form I verb and the following prepositional attachment; lexical rows support extension beyond healthy bounds.

topics.headline: completed uncommon lengthening carries diagnostic force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lengthening is narrated as a completed stage in the exemplar chain and uses an uncommon finite verb.
topics.reason: Corpus rarity and perfective grammar support the diagnostic weight of the verb, without adding a new local object.

topics.headline: power and means senses color but do not replace duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that length can carry capacity or means in the root field, while the local clause still selects prolonged duration.
topics.reason: V4 range permits power and means associations, but QAC and syntax require the local sense of the span growing long.

words.gloss_range: duration resting upon the prior group
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمُ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhimu}}) places the lengthened span over them. The preposition and pronoun make time feel superimposed on the same comparison group.

topics.headline: alayhim places duration over the exemplar group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prolonged time rests upon the prior recipients as pressure borne by them.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition plus pronoun attachment to the lengthening clause; the prepositional semantics support superimposed pressure.

words.gloss_range: bounded span as causal hinge
words.root_gloss_range: a bounded span or term; locally the definite span becomes the hinge between received scripture and hard hearts.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمَدُ}} ({{tr:al-amadu}}) is the definite span that lengthened and became the grammatical actor in the warning. Its bounded, rare form makes the delay specific enough to become causally dangerous, and the stretched sound of the phrase lets the delay be heard before hardening lands.

topics.headline: the definite span itself becomes the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the span is the grammatical actor that lengthens, turning delay into a named causal force.
topics.reason: QAC marks the nominative definite noun as subject of the lengthening verb; grammar rows support its prominence.

topics.headline: bounded rare span sharpens the causal hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is about a bounded span that became dangerous, not endless time in general.
topics.reason: V4 and occurrence evidence support bounded term language and hapax rarity; cross-references to 3:30 and 72:25 show nominal term usage without changing the local subject function.

topics.headline: long-vowel sound slows the causal chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audible slowing around the lengthened span, matching the semantic stretch of delay.
topics.reason: The phonetic row coheres with the local long-duration semantics but remains a sound-texture payoff.

words.gloss_range: second consequence link into hardening
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the lengthened span into the immediate lead-in to hardening. The second fa completes the domino chain: receipt, delay, then hearts made hard.

topics.headline: second fa turns lengthened time into hardening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hardening is presented as the result of the prolonged span, not as an unrelated moral aside.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as a result conjunction, and discourse rows connect it to the first fa in the double consequence chain.

words.gloss_range: completed hardening as opposite of yielding
words.root_gloss_range: hardness, stiffness, and imperviousness; locally the heart-state opposite of yielding humility.
words.prose: {{ar:قَسَتْ}} ({{tr:qasat}}) narrates the failed outcome as completed hardening. Its physical hardness field answers the earlier demand for yielding hearts with a resistant, impermeable opposite. Feminine singular agreement makes the broken-plural hearts sound like one collective hardening event, while the known heart-hardening echo (2:74) and abrasive sound texture reinforce the warning.

topics.headline: completed hardening answers the demanded humility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's negative pole: the hearts that should yield are contrasted with hearts whose hardening has already completed.
topics.reason: QAC confirms perfect Form I, and discourse rows bind this verb to the earlier yielding verb and repeated hearts.

topics.headline: physical hardness becomes moral impermeability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spiritual failure as tactile resistance: hard, stiff, and unreceptive to reminder.
topics.reason: V4 root senses and semantic rows support physical hardness mapped to hearts in the local clause.

topics.headline: collective agreement, 2:74 echo, and hard sound reinforce the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the collective grammar and a known heart-hardening echo (2:74), with harsh sound texture supporting the semantic hardness.
topics.reason: QAC supports feminine singular agreement with the broken-plural subject; intertext and phonetic rows are reinforcing evidence, not a replacement for the local parse.

words.gloss_range: same possessed hearts under opposite fate
words.root_gloss_range: turning or changeability of the inner organ; locally the same possessed plural hearts now stand under hardening.
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:qulūbuhum}}) repeats the possessed plural heart, but now as the subject of hardening. The same kind of inner organ that should turn and yield is shown frozen in the comparison group, and that frozen-heart field leads into the final boundary-exit verdict.

topics.headline: same possessed hearts return under hardening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same heart-word returns with the opposite predicate, making the ayah's two halves hinge on changed heart-state.
topics.reason: QAC marks the possessed broken plural as subject of the hardening verb, while discourse rows confirm the repetition against word 8.

topics.headline: suffix keeps the completed hardening on the exemplar group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hardened hearts belong grammatically to the comparison group, while still warning the believers by example.
topics.reason: Referent profiles support the suffix resolution to those given the Book; plural form preserves distributed accountability.

topics.headline: the turning organ is shown frozen and moving toward fisq
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the organ of turning has lost its turnability and now leads into the final boundary-exit verdict.
topics.reason: V4 root imagery and collocation rows support the turning-heart plus hardening and fisq progression locally.

words.gloss_range: resumptive verdict after the causal chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resets the syntax after the double-fa chain and opens the final nominal verdict. The ending is no longer another event in sequence but a settled assessment, and the many-from-them fisq formula recurs as a same-surah refrain (57:26; 57:27).

topics.headline: wa resets from causal chain to nominal verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is a settled assessment after the chain, not merely one more event.
topics.reason: QAC marks a conjunction opening the nominal sentence, and discourse rows support a reset after the double fa sequence.

topics.headline: the closing formula joins nearby same-surah verdicts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the many-from-them fisq formula recurs as a section-level refrain in 57:26 and 57:27.
topics.reason: Cross-reference rows provide concrete same-surah parallels; they illuminate formulaic recurrence without changing the local conjunction.

words.gloss_range: many, not all, as verdict subject
words.root_gloss_range: manyness, abundance, and multiplication; locally an indefinite quantity-subject for the final verdict.
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:kathīrun}}) makes quantity the subject of the final verdict. It is severe because it says many, but it is not totalizing, and the abundance field gives the warning communal weight. The quantity term also joins boundary-exit as a recurring community-failure pattern in the surah and wider corpus (57:20; 57:26; 57:27).

topics.headline: many is severe but non-totalizing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is heavy because it says many, yet it avoids claiming every member of the group.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the nominative subject of the nominal sentence; lexical and form rows support indefinite many rather than totality or most.

topics.headline: quantity becomes the subject of the final verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the causal example generalized into a standing quantity-verdict: many from the prior group occupy the final category.
topics.reason: QAC and grammar rows support the nominal structure with the quantity term as subject and the final participle as predicate.

topics.headline: abundance root joins a recurring fisq pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that quantity and boundary-exit form a recognizable warning pattern in the surah and wider corpus.
topics.reason: Collocation evidence supports the quantity-plus-fisq pairing and same-surah recurrence, while local grammar keeps the word as subject.

words.gloss_range: partitive subset from the exemplar group
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) extracts the judged subset from the prior group. The verdict is grammatically tied to them while preserving the distinction between many and all.

topics.headline: minhum extracts the judged subset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict falls on many from among them, not on the whole group without remainder.
topics.reason: QAC identifies min plus attached pronoun as partitive; grammar rows support subset extraction.

topics.headline: pronoun ties the verdict to prior scripture recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict is grammatically attached to the comparison group while functioning as a warning to believers.
topics.reason: Referent profiles resolve the suffix to those given the Book, matching the CRITICAL claim.

words.gloss_range: ongoing boundary-exit as terminal verdict
words.root_gloss_range: exiting or breaking out of a boundary; locally an active-participle identity of ongoing moral boundary-exit.
words.prose: {{ar:فَٰسِقُونَ}} ({{tr:fāsiqūn}}) supplies the final predicate: many are ongoing boundary-exiters. The active participle, root image, and final position make the warning land as a persistent state, not a one-time lapse. The same-surah failed-reception formula (57:26; 57:27) and the slow nominal cadence let the verdict settle at the close.

topics.headline: active participle supplies the terminal verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by naming an ongoing identity, not by narrating a single past sin.
topics.reason: QAC marks the active participle as predicate of the nominal sentence; discourse rows support its terminal position.

topics.headline: root image makes fisq boundary-exit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the moral verdict as exiting a proper boundary, the opposite endpoint from the opening faith identity.
topics.reason: V4 root imagery supports exit/breach semantics, and local discourse connects faith at the opening with fisq at the close.

topics.headline: same-surah formula and cadence make the verdict land
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verdict as part of a same-surah failed-reception formula (57:26; 57:27), with a slow nominal cadence at the close.
topics.reason: Cross-reference and phonetic rows reinforce the closing verdict; boundary linkage to walāya is kept as thematic resonance, not a new local sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question built on يأن, followed by prolonged time, an endpoint, and hardening.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching ripeness opens a response-window; stretching time beyond its proper end converts delay into loss of cardiac softness.

activation_trace.role: Attaining ripeness makes the opening question a reached maturity point, not a vague appeal.
Long duration supplies the temporal extension that carries response past its fitting moment.
A thing's limit or terminus gives the delay a consequential endpoint.
Loss of the heart's softness is the resulting state produced by overlong deferral.

changed_reading.before: A general rebuke to become more devout.
changed_reading.after: A maturity alarm: answer descended truth when its time has ripened, before an extended interval remakes the heart's responsiveness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خشع, قلوب, ذكر, نزل, and الحق form a directed inward event.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth arrives and is re-presented by remembrance; the heart, a turning inner core, lowers and settles rather than holding its prior orientation.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the incoming truth that initiates the inward change.
Reality-fixed truth supplies the stable object to which the heart is asked to conform.
Re-presenting what was absent from attention makes remembrance an active recovery operation.
Turning something from one face to another makes the heart the site of reorientation.
Lowering and quiet submission supplies the new posture produced by that reorientation.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance should cause an undifferentiated pious feeling.
changed_reading.after: Delivered reality is to be recovered into attention until the heart physically-imagistically turns, lowers, and settles toward it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A light that once advances becomes inaccessible across an enclosing wall while waiting and unstable allure consume the response-window; delay therefore has spatial and social consequences.

activation_trace.role: Reached ripeness anchors the context sequence to the focus ayah's expiring moment.
Purposeful movement makes received light a trajectory that can still advance.
Illumination supplies the visible state whose availability is at stake.
An enclosing raised wall materializes delayed response as separation.
An entrance marks the threshold that postponement fails to cross in time.
Waiting and watching name postponement as a practiced mechanism.
A glittering but unstable deception explains why continued delay can feel safe.

structural_cues: 57:12-14 moves from light running ahead, through a request to wait, to a wall and retrospective self-accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advancing light, a threshold, waiting, and deception; I infer that waiting causes missed access. A live alternative is that the wall only reveals an already fixed distinction.

changed_reading.before: The long interval merely dulls memory.
changed_reading.after: Repeated postponement spends a finite opening until a once-crossable relation to light becomes a separating boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's low, dormant-earth image for خشوع is followed by earth restored after death, converting heart-hardness from an exclusively terminal image into dormant receptivity that can be reanimated.

activation_trace.role: Low dormant earth embeds an ecological substrate inside the focus request for humility.
The heart's lost softness names the apparently deadened condition to be revised.
Earth-life through rain and growth supplies a concrete recovery process.
Soft fertile ground supplies latent receptivity beneath apparent lifelessness.
Dead land gives heart-hardness a dormant material analogue rather than only a verdict.

structural_cues: 57:17 immediately follows the hardened-heart warning with the declaration that earth is revived after death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dormant earth in خشع and explicit land-revival; I map soil receptivity onto cardiac receptivity. Literal land revival or resurrection remains a live alternative without the heart-to-soil arrow.

changed_reading.before: Hardening is a fixed endpoint from which the ayah only warns believers away.
changed_reading.after: Hardening resembles dead ground: grave but not necessarily irreversible, because renewed descent can restore receptive life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The long term becomes an organic sequence: descent stimulates growth, growth dries and yellows, then dryness breaks into fragments. Hardening can thus follow an impressive initial response rather than simple nonresponse.

activation_trace.role: Long duration anchors the growth cycle to the focus ayah's temporal hazard.
Material dryness and hardness supply the cycle's cardiac endpoint.
Rain descending from the sky supplies the initiating stimulus analogous to descended truth.
Vegetation emerging from earth shows that an initial response may genuinely flourish.
Plant drying and yellowing introduces decline from within the growth process.
Visible yellowing marks the loss of fresh responsiveness.
Dry matter breaking into fragments gives prolonged hardness a disintegrative outcome.

structural_cues: 57:20 presents rain, admired growth, drying, yellowing, and debris as one compressed temporal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the full plant cycle and the focus supplies descent, duration, and hardness; I transfer the cycle to heart-response. The live alternative confines the analogy to worldly life-cycle rather than belief-history.

changed_reading.before: Those who harden never truly responded to truth.
changed_reading.after: A heart may sprout under truth and still desiccate over time; early flourishing does not replace continuing receptivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iron's resistant hardness is paired with balance, justice, and benefit; the focus fault is therefore sharpened as unmeasured, inaccessible hardness, not firmness as such.

activation_trace.role: Dry resistant hardness supplies the property whose moral valence is being tested.
A balance of justice supplies the governing measure for force and firmness.
Equity supplies the outward purpose by which firmness is judged.
Iron and resistant solidity provide a packet-positive instance of hardness.
Benefit rather than harm supplies the practical test of disciplined hardness.

structural_cues: 57:25 coordinates descended book, balance, justice, iron, force, and human benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the juxtaposition of measure and useful iron; I infer that measure governs hardness. A live alternative treats these as parallel gifts without making balance the controller of force.

changed_reading.before: The heart is condemned because every kind of hardness is intrinsically bad.
changed_reading.after: The condemned heart is impermeable and unmeasured; firmness remains potentially useful when answerable to truth, equity, and benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A heart-practice can begin with a newly constructed discipline yet fail through deficient watching and preservation; over time, unmaintained form ends in boundary-breach rather than living fidelity.

activation_trace.role: Long time supplies the interval in which maintenance can fail.
Loss of cardiac softness supplies the focus outcome needing a process explanation.
The heart as understanding and tender faculty locates the later practice in the same inward substrate.
Creating without a prior model supplies the constructed practice that requires upkeep.
Watching and attending to a matter names the maintenance operation that was not sustained.
Moist contents leaving their skin supplies a material image of final boundary-breach.

structural_cues: 57:27 repeats hearts and 'many of them are fasiqun' while placing failed due care between an initial heart-gift and the final breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated heart/fisq language, constructed discipline, and failed care; I infer that nonmaintenance is the arrow from elapsed time to hardening. The live alternative is a separate historical failure, not a causal gloss on 57:16.

changed_reading.before: Generational distance hardens hearts simply because time passes.
changed_reading.after: Time hardens through neglected maintenance: even a heart-centered discipline can become an uncared-for shell whose adherents eventually pass outside it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The paired dry-hardness and moist-fruit-leaving-its-skin images are an odd material cross-reading, but both are directly anchored in focus branches. Render only as an exploratory analogy, not as a replacement definition of فسق or a denial of moral agency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus closes قست قلوبهم with فاسقون, placing hardness beside a branch image of contents exiting a skin.

activation_trace.role: Dry solidity supplies one material failure-state of the interior.
A moist date leaving its peel supplies the contrasting failure of containment.

changed_reading.before: Hardness and fisq are two generic moral labels.
changed_reading.after: The ending can be carried as two linked material failures: the interior dries rigid, then the containing form no longer holds what belonged within it.

strongest_changes: The opening question marks a ripeness deadline whose repeated deferral can become actual separation from advancing light.
The immediate dead-earth revival revises hardening from a purely terminal verdict into potentially revivable dormancy.
The rain-to-debris cycle shows that genuine early growth can still desiccate without continued receptivity.
Failed care in 57:27 gives elapsed time a mechanism: inherited heart-practice hardens when it is not actively watched and preserved.
summary.what_was_special: The context made time active rather than empty: delay closes thresholds, organic response dries, useful firmness needs measure, and inherited tenderness needs maintenance.
remaining_uncertainties: The heart-to-soil and heart-to-plant transfers are strongly sequenced but remain reader-supplied analogical arrows.
The claim that balance governs iron is live but less certain than reading book, balance, and iron as parallel provisions.
The shell-breach reading of فسق should remain visibly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Due time is ripeness, not merely elapsed duration.** ء ن ي B003 is reaching due completion, while ط و ل B003 is long duration and ء م د B001 an end limit or bounded term. The opening question is answered by the counterexample of a term that became long. The packet supplies ripeness versus prolongation; I infer missed responsiveness at maturity -> duration hardens what should have opened. **ألم يأن** asks whether belief has reached its actionable completion.
2. **Humility is a lowering that permits descent to enter.** خ ش ع B001 is low humble submission and B002 low desolate ground; ن ز ل B002 is what has been sent down. The heart is the receiving site between **تخشع** and **ما نزل**. The packet supplies lowered ground and descent; I infer lowering -> receptivity. The ayah reads humility as making the heart topographically able to receive truth.
3. **Hardness is failed reversal of the inward faculty.** ق ل ب B001 is heart/inward faculty, but B004 is turning and reversing; ق س و B002 is hardening of the heart. The twice-named hearts stand on opposite sides of prolonged time. The packet supplies a reversible faculty becoming hard; I infer delay -> loss of turnability. Hardness means not just reduced feeling but an interior no longer able to reorient.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:17 immediately supplies the correction: dead ground can be revived, so hardness is not the last image. 57:27 later shows the same temporal failure at communal scale, where an adopted discipline is not guarded through time.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The heart as ground that can receive or resist descent.** `خ ش ع` **B002** supplies low, dormant, dusty ground; `ق س و` **B001** supplies hard dry ground and **B002** its hardening in the heart. The fixed ayah already places what “descended” beside those states; 57:17 revives dead earth and 57:20 supplies rain, growth, yellowing, and debris. The packet supplies the material analogy, while I infer the irrigation arrow: descended reminder can soften receptive ground. Humbling of hearts therefore reads as ecological receptivity, and hardness as desiccation rather than emotion alone.
2. **A due-time window for reversal.** `ء ن ي` **B003** supplies reaching due completion, `ء م د` **B001** a bounded term, `ط و ل` **B003** long duration, and `ق ل ب` **B004** turning or reversing. Their sequence moves from “has it come due?” to a term prolonged until hearts harden; 57:21 then commands racing ahead. The packet supplies timing, limit, reversal, and urgency; I infer that a heart has a responsive interval in which turning remains possible. The opening question thus reads as a deadline for reversal, not a timeless appeal to feel humble.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:17 made the low-ground/hard-ground model explicit through dead earth revived, and 57:20 completed it with rain, growth, drying, and debris. 57:21's race then corrected the due-time question toward urgent movement before receptivity hardens.

baseline.text: İnananların kalplerinin Allah'ı anma ve inen gerçek karşısında saygıyla boyun eğme zamanı gelmedi mi? Daha önce kendilerine kitap verilenler gibi olmasınlar: Üzerlerinden uzun zaman geçti, böylece kalpleri katılaştı. Onların çoğu yoldan çıkmıştır.

findings.text: Vaktin gelmesi, yalnız sürenin geçmesi değil, inancın eyleme dönüşecek olgunluğa ulaşmasıdır; bu karşılık geciktikçe sınırlı fırsat penceresi kalbi sertleştirir.
Saygıyla boyun eğen kalp, inen gerçeği alabilen alçak ve açık bir zemin; katılaşan kalp ise aynı inişe direnç gösteren kuru bir zemin gibi işlev görür.
Kalbin katılaşması yalnız duygunun azalması değil, yönünü çevirip yeniden karşılık verebilen iç yetinin dönüş kabiliyetini kaybetmesidir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 Receptive Substrate: Hard Core to Living Ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Reception depends on material disposition; an inner or earthly substrate may harden into sterility or soften into life under a descending address.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The humility root also supplies a low, dormant landscape, making the heart and earth parallel receiving grounds rather than a loose moral simile.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Long Exposure Calcifies the Inner Core
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Extended duration acts on the heart's core until a faculty meant to lower itself becomes dry, hard, and unresponsive to reminder.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an endpoint or due term `quranic:root_000050:B001/m01`; prolonged duration `quranic:root_000959:B003/m01`; heart `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`; inner core or essence `quranic:root_001248:B002/m01`; hardness and dryness like unproductive land `quranic:root_001227:B001/m01`; a hard heart stripped of softness and mercy `quranic:root_001227:B002/m01`; lowering and humility `quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`; reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Time does not merely pass over the heart; it alters the receiving material. The core loses softness, assumes the dryness of non-growing ground, and can no longer perform the lowering movement appropriate to reminder.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A low and dormant ground is revived from uncultivated death, while disclosed signs activate the faculty that restrains ignorance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: low dormant ground `quranic:root_000412:B002/m01`; dead uncultivated land `quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`; stillness and dormancy `quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`; soft fertile earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; earth enlivened through rain and growth `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; visible sign or landmark `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; explanatory disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; reason that restrains ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lowered quality sought from the heart has an earthy counterpart: ground lying still before revival. Life restores growth to that substrate, and explanation performs the corresponding cognitive work by making signs available to a reason capable of restraining inert ignorance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyim dizisi bu dalda ağırdan alma, geciktirme, bekletme, acele etmeme ve yumuşak başlı davranma anlamlarını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği korur; yemek olgunlaşması, gece bölümleri, kap adı ve soru sözcüğü anlamları ayrı dallardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yavaş davranma ve geciktirme alanıyla sınırlıdır; zamanın gelmesi veya nesne kabı anlamına taşınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak ad ve eylem biçimleriyle kişi niteleyen kullanımlar ayrılır; kişi örnekleri ana anlamı genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir işte veya kişiye karşı acele etmeyip ağırdan alma, bekleme, geciktirme ve yumuşak başlı davranma alanını kapsar. Kişi nitelikleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Acele etmeden, ölçülü ve yavaş davranma çekirdeği vardır.
Bir gelişi veya şeyi geciktirme, bekletme ve alıkoyma bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.
Birini aceleye sürmeyip onun için bekleme ayrı bir uygulamadır.
Acele etmeyen, ağırbaşlı kişi veya kadın nitelemeleri örnek kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yumuşak davranma, ağırbaşlı rahatlık ve dinginlik çekirdeğini birlikte verir; yolculukta kendine yavaş ve ölçülü davranma buyruğu ile kişi ve geceler için kullanılan rahatlık nitelemeleri aynı alana bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yumuşaklık ve rahatlık alanındadır; yavaş yürüyüş, yük yanı, zaman anlamı veya yapı adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimler rahatlık ve yumuşak davranmayı verir; yolculuk buyruğu yalnız kendi kalıbına bağlı tutulmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir davranışta veya durumda sertlikten uzak, rahat ve dingin biçimde davranma ya da öyle olma anlamıdır; yolculukta kendini zorlamadan ilerleme buyruğu bu çekirdeğin özel kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Sertlik ve zorlamadan uzak yumuşak davranma çekirdeğini taşır.
Rahatlık ve dinginlik, kişi veya gece niteliği olarak da söylenir.
Yolculukta kendine yavaş ve ölçülü davranma buyruğu bu alana bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Verilen tanıklıklar anlamı yumuşak davranma, rahatlık ve dinginlik çevresinde toplar; yolculukta kendini yormadan gitme buyruğu ile kişi ve geceler için kullanılan rahat nitelemeleri aynı çekirdeği destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çekirdeği, hem davranıştaki yumuşaklığı hem de rahat ve dingin olma halini birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşak davranma ile rahat ve dingin olma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolculukta kişiye ölçülü ve rahat ilerlemesini söyleyen kalıp için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yolculukta zorlamadan davranma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişi veya gece niteliği olarak dingin rahatlık anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişi veya gece gibi bir varlığın huzurlu ve yumuşak halini anlatan kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Rahat ve dingin olma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Etkin yumuşak davranma ve yolculuk buyruğu yönünü vermez.

error_profile.preserves: Yolculukta ağırdan alma çağrışımının küçük bir bölümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yumuşak davranma, rahatlık ve dinginlik çekirdeğini karşılamaz.
error_profile.adds: Yürüyüş biçimini dalın genel anlamıymış gibi ekler.
error_profile.collision: Komşu alanlarda yavaş yürüme ayrı bir anlam odağıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Rahat yaşama, kolayca elde etme ve ağırbaşlı duruş gibi daha geniş rahatlık alanlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de zorlama ve sertlikten uzak rahat, dingin bir hali anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal daha dar biçimde yumuşak davranma ve dingin rahatlık çevresinde kalır; komşu dal rahat yaşama ve güçlük çekmeden elde etme gibi daha geniş sonuçlara açılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yumuşak davranma çekirdeği ve yolculukta kendini yormama buyruğu öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Denizin durgunluğu, yaşamın veya eylemin kaygısız sürmesi gibi daha geniş sakinlik örnekleri bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sertlik ve huzursuzluktan uzak bir sakinlik alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal sakinliği daha genel durumlara yayar; bu dal davranışın yumuşak ve rahat oluşuna bağlı kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yük kabının iki yanından biri ve denge yükü anlamını verir; eşeğin yiyip içince karnının dolup iki yanının uzaması da bu yan-yük görünüşüne benzetilen bağlı bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yükün yanı ve ona benzeyen doluluk biçimidir; rahatlık, zaman veya yapı anlamına taşınmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim yük yanını bildirir; iki yanlı çıkın ve hayvanın yanlarının dolması kalıba bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir yük kabının veya dengeli yükün yan parçası anlamıdır; hayvanın yiyip içince karnı ve yanları şişerek bu yük yanına benzemesi özel benzetmeli kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Yük kabının ya da dengeli yükün bir yanını adlandırır.
İki yanlı çıkın veya yük düzeni, karşılıklı iki yük yanı olarak anlaşılır.
Hayvanın dolup iki yanının uzaması, yük yanına benzeyen biçim olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklık dalı yük kabının yan parçası ve denge yükü anlamında toplar; iki yanlı çıkın ifadesi ile hayvanın karnı ve böğürleri dolunca aynı biçime benzetilmesi bu anlamın bağlı kullanımlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli zaman veya sıra gelen zamanlar anlamını açıkça verir; bir işi ara ara yapıp bırakma örneği çoğul ve tekrarlanan zaman dilimleri yönünü destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimler belirli zaman ve zamanlar içindir; bir işi ara ara yapma kalıbı bu zaman anlamının özel bağlamıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük ve kemerli yapı bölümü anlamını verir; belirli saray yapısına yapılan gönderme bir örnektir, çoğul biçimler ise aynı mimari adın biçimsel uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sabit dua sozunu ve onu soylemeyi anlatir; komsu dal korkunun kalkmasi ve guvenilirlik iliskilerini anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dua sonunda kabul istegi bildiren sozdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip kabul etmektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kabul fikri cok genel duzeyde ikisine de temas edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir soylem formuludur; komsu dal bir haberin veya hakikatin dogrulanmasi ve benimsenmesidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأمن ضد الخوف، ولا الأمانة، ولا الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، ولا أمن التي هي أم من وليست من الباب.

Ortak bag kalbin yatismasi ve kabul duygusudur, fakat her dalin siniri guvenlik, tasdik ve dua formulu olarak ayri tutulmalidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu tanıklık, insanın başını, bedenini ya da bakışını aşağı indirerek boyun eğmesini temel alır; bu durum sesin durulmasına ve içteki yakarışın organlara yansımasına da uzanır. Verilen çerçeve bu bedensel, davranışsal ve sessel görünümleri aynı alçalma ve boyun eğme çekirdeğinde doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insanın boyun eğen ve sakinleşen durumuyla sınırlıdır; arazi, gök cisimleri, deve hörgücü ve göğüsten salgı çıkarma anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler genel boyun eğme ve alçalma durumunu verir; bakışın indirilmesi, seslerin dinmesi ve organların etkilenmesi yalnız kendi yapıları içinde yorumlanır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin boyun eğerek başını, bedenini veya bakışını aşağı indirmesi ve dingin bir tutum almasıdır. Bu iç yöneliş, belirli yapılarda sesin alçalması ya da organların sakinleşmiş duruşuyla görünür olur.

facets.statement: Kişi kendini alçaltan bir tutumla boyun eğer ve dinginleşir.
Başın, göğsün veya bakışın aşağı indirilmesi bu tutumun bedensel görünümüdür.
Seslere uygulandığında seslerin kesilmesini, durulmasını ve alçalmasını bildirir.
İçteki yakarış ve boyun eğiş, organların sakin ve alçalmış duruşunda dışa vurabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar alçalma, boyun eğme ve dinginlik çekirdeğinde birleşir; baş, göğüs, bakış, ses ve organlar bu çekirdeğin farklı görünüm alanlarıdır. Kimi kullanımlarda eğilerek durma, kimi kullanımlarda ise böyle görünmeye çalışma ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanın kendini alçaltan iç ve dış tutumunu, bedensel sakinlikle birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğme, alçalma ve dinginleşme çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başın ya da bakışın yere yöneltildiği bedensel görünüm için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aşağı yönelen baş ve bakış hareketini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Seslerin kesildiği, sakinleştiği ve işitilirliğinin azaldığı yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin durulması ve alçalması sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İçteki boyun eğişin organların sakin duruşunda görünür olduğu bağlamı açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: İç durum ile organların görünür duruşu arasındaki bağı korur.

error_profile.loses: Boyun eğme, dinginleşme ve beden, bakış ya da sesteki görünür belirtileri eksiltir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bedene, sese ve bakışa yayılan sakinleşmiş alçalma görünümü vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sinmişlik ve güçsüzce boyun eğme vurgusu daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dingin boyun eğiş / sinerek boyun eğiş
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin kendini alçaltıp boyun eğmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, boyun eğişin baş, beden, bakış, ses ve organlarda beliren dingin görünümünü kapsar. Komşu dal ise boyun eğmeyi özellikle sinmiş ve güçsüz bir durumda kalma yönüyle sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir hareket olmadan da sürebilen dingin ve alçalmış durumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eğilme hareketini hem tapınmada hem başka durumlarda kullanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de bedenin aşağı yönelmesi kendini alçaltma anlamı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir kişinin genel tutumunu ve bunun bakış, ses ve organlardaki belirtilerini anlatır. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise doğrudan eğilme hareketidir; bu yüzden sıradan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Baş, bakış veya sesin alçalmasıyla da gerçekleşebilen geniş bir durumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Alnı yere koymaya kadar varan belirli bir yere kapanma hareketini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bedenin alçalması boyun eğmenin görünür belirtisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın gerçekleşmesi için alnın yere konması gerekmez; dinginlik ve bakışın ya da sesin alçalması yeterli olabilir. Komşu dal ise yere kapanmanın belirli bedensel hareketini ve bu hareketle bildirilen boyun eğmeyi merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: İnsanın boyun eğişiyle doğrudan karışabilecek üç aday seçildi. Koşma, diz çökme ve belirli el ya da baş işaretleri ayrı hareket çekirdeklerine sahipti; öteki adaylar ya korku ve uysallık gibi daha dar durumları veriyor ya da yalnız aynı kökün fiziksel alçalma dallarını temsil ediyordu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خشوع الرجل والمتخشع والضراعة والإخبات والتذلل وطأطأة الرأس وغض البصر وسكون الصوت وخشوع الجوارح والركوع

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على التطامن؛ تطامن وطأطا رأسه؛ الخاشع المستكين والراكع (maqayis)؛ الخشوع رميك ببصرك إلى الأرض؛ متخشع متضرع؛ خشعت الأصوات أي سكنت (ayn)؛ الخاشع المستكين؛ الخاشع الراكع؛ خشع ببصره إذا غضه (jamhara)؛ الخشوع الخضوع؛ التخشع تكلف الخشوع (sihah)؛ التخشع لله الإخبات والتذلل؛ خشع الرجل إذا رمى ببصره إلى الأرض؛ الخشوع في البدن والصوت والبصر (tahdhib)؛ الخشوع الضراعة؛ إذا ضرع القلب خشعت الجوارح (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili tanıklık yalnız cansız ve kuru toprağı değil, yere yakın bir arazi parçasını veya küçük yükseltiyi; ayrıca yapıya bağlı olarak tozlu yöreyi, kurumuş toprağı ve çöküp yere yaklaşan duvarı kapsar. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak onu yalnızca alçak ve cansız arazi diye sunan görüntü daha geniş ve katmanlı bir tanımla düzeltilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yere yakın arazi adı dalın yalın çekirdeğidir; kuruluk, tozluluk ve duvarın çökmesi yalnız ilgili adlarla kurulan yapılara aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad, yere yakın arazi parçasını veya küçük yükseltiyi belirtir; yöre, toprak ve duvarla kurulan kullanımların tozluluk, kuruluk ve çökme anlamları bu ada genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalın kullanımda yere yakın duran bir arazi parçasını, sırtı veya küçük yükseltiyi belirtir; tanıklıklar yüzeyin düzleşmiş ya da pürüzlü oluşunda ayrışır. Belirli yapılarda bu alçalma görüntüsü tozlu ve yerleşimsiz yöreye, kuruyup cansızlaşmış toprağa veya çökerek yerle bir olan duvara uygulanır.

facets.statement: Yere yakın duran arazi parçası, sırt veya küçük yükselti yalın adın çekirdeğidir.
Arazi parçası kimi tanıklıkta düzleşmiş ve kolay geçilir, kiminde pürüzlü olarak betimlenir.
Yöre veya yer için kullanıldığında tozlu ve yerleşimsiz olmayı bildirir.
Toprak için kullanıldığında yağmursuz kalıp kurumuş, bitkisiz ve cansız duruma gelmeyi bildirir.
Duvar için kullanıldığında çöküp yüksekliğini yitirerek yer düzeyine inmeyi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yere yakınlık ve alçalmış görünüm çevresinde birleşir. Bunun yanında arazi parçasının düz ya da pürüzlü oluşunda ayrışır; tozlu ve boş yöre, yağmursuz kalmış bitkisiz toprak ve çökmüş duvar kullanımları da aynı toplu iddiada yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın adın arazi parçası, sırt veya küçük yükselti bildiren ortak çekirdeği için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi türünü ve yere yakın duruşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yöre veya yerleşim alanının tozlu ve üzerinde ev bulunmayan durumunu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Tozlu ve yerleşimsiz yöre niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yağmur almayan toprağın kuruduğu ve üzerinde yeşillik kalmadığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuruma, bitkisizleşme ve cansızlaşma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir duvarın yüksekliğini yitirerek yere yaklaşması veya yer düzeyine inmesi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duvarın çökmesi ve yüksekliğini yitirmesi sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda bitkisizlik yalnız toprağa bağlı uzantılardan biridir; yalın çekirdek yere yakın arazi biçimidir. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise bitki örtüsünün ortadan kalkmasıdır ve arazinin alçak olmasını gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Küçük yükselti, pürüzlü parça, kuru toprak ve çökmüş duvar görünümlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kolay geçilen düz araziyi ve böyle bir araziye inmeyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de düzleşmiş ve alçak görünen arazi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yere yakınlık çevresinde farklı arazi biçimlerini ve yapıya bağlı uzantıları toplar. Komşu dal ise engebeli arazinin karşıtı olan kolay geçilir düzlüğü merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Doğrudan arazi biçimi veya bitkisizlik kesişimi bulunan üç aday seçildi. Yüksek arazi, verimli çukur, dağlara giriş ve kumluk gibi öteki alan kartları yalnız aynı çevreyi paylaşır; insan, gök cismi ve hörgüç dallarıysa fiziksel alçalma imgesine rağmen ayrı çekirdeklere sahiptir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخشعة من الأرض والقف الخاشع والأكمة المتواضعة والبلدة المغبرة والمكان الخاشع والأرض الخاشعة الهامدة والجدار المتداعي

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklık iki göksel yapıyı birlikte verir: güneş söz konusu olduğunda tutulma veya kararma, yıldızlar söz konusu olduğunda ufka inip gözden kaybolmaya yaklaşma. Yıldızın batışını öne çıkaran dal görüntüsü kullanılabilir, ancak güneş tutulmasını aynı olaymış gibi göstermemek için iki yapı açıkça ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız verilen güneş ve yıldız yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kararma, düşme veya batma anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız güneşin tutulmasını ve yıldızların ufka inmesini bildiren iki göksel yapıyla sınırlıdır; bunlardan yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız gök cisimleriyle kurulan yapılarda, güneşin tutulup kararmasını veya yıldızların ufka inerek gözden kaybolmaya yaklaşmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Gök cisminin görünürlüğü ya kararma ya da ufka iniş yoluyla azalır.

Yıldızlarla kurulan yapıda ufka iniş ve batmaya yaklaşma anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dalın bütün verisi tek bir tanıklık kümesinde iki ayrı göksel yapıya ayrılır; güneş için tutulma, yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolma bildirilir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, güneş için tutulmayı; yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolmayı bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulması ve yıldızların batmaya yaklaşmasıyla sınırlı iki yapı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyin yokluğa çekilmesini ve çeşitli ışıklı gök cisimlerinin batışını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulmasını veya yıldızların ufka inmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın süreçleri güneş tutulması ve yıldızların ufka hareketidir. Komşu dal ise ayın aylık evresinde ışıklı bölümünün küçülmesini anlatır; ortak sonuç benzer olsa da süreç ve gök cismi farklıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Görünmezleşme sonucunu taşıyıp süreç farkını açıklayan üç aday seçildi. Doğuş, ateş ışığı, gezegenlerin geri hareketi ve güneşin gökteki başka konum değişimleri farklı çekirdeklere sahipti; kardeş dallar ise yalnız alçalma imgesi üzerinden uzaktan bağlantılıydı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklıklar devenin hörgücündeki yağın tükenmesini, geriye çok az bölüm kalmasını ve tepenin aşağı çökmesini birlikte bildirir. Verilen dal görüntüsü hem süreci hem de ortaya çıkan biçim değişikliğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız devenin hörgücüyle kurulan yapıya aittir; genel zayıflama, kesme veya yüksekliğini yitirme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız devenin hörgücündeki yağ kaybını ve buna bağlı çökmeyi bildiren yapıyla sınırlıdır; yalın bir zayıflama anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devenin hörgücünün yağını yitirip büyük ölçüde erimesi ve tepesinin aşağı çökmesidir.

facets.statement: Devenin hörgücündeki yağ tükenir ve hörgüçten yalnız az bir bölüm kalır.
Yağ kaybının sonucu olarak hörgücün tepesi belirginliğini yitirip aşağı çöker.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar hörgücün büyük ölçüde erimesinde birleşir; daha ayrıntılı anlatım yağın tükenmesini ve hörgüç tepesinin aşağı çökmesini aynı sürecin aşamaları olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin hörgücündeki yağ kaybını ve bunun sonucundaki biçim değişikliğini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağın tükenmesi ile tepenin aşağı çökmesi arasındaki süreci korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir devenin hörgücü yağını yitirip geriye çok azı kaldığında kullanılır.

Yağ kaybı ve küçülme yönünü genel olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Deve hörgücünün tepesinin çökmesi sonucunu açıkça göstermez.
error_profile.adds: Bütün bedenin veya herhangi bir varlığın güç ve ağırlık kaybetmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Hayvanın genel olarak zayıflamasıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız deve hörgücünün yağını yitirip çökmesini bildirir. Komşu dal bütün bedenin zayıflamasını merkez alır; hörgücün özel biçim değişikliğini gerektirmez.
